Also this will be liable to physical settlement, below policy will be applicable for trades in this scrip from tomorrow  1. This scrip will be not allowed to trade in fno segment for any fresh position and only square off of the existing position will be allowed - on 3rd and 4th Apr 2025. 2. Client will be required to pay full contract value to avoid rms square off action on 4th APR 2025. 3. Scrip Haircut will be increased to 100% in BO and RMS - on 3rd APR 2025  4. Client will be not allow fresh pos in intraday and margin product , Delivery product will be allowed- on 3rd and 4th Apr 2025. 5. MTF shortfall position will be informed separately on 3rd APR and square off by rms on 4th Apr. 2025.
